mentions.name: Nokia 1100 Linux LTE replacement motherboard
mentions.description: A replacement motherboard for the Nokia 1100 that runs Linux and supports LTE, built on an Allwinner T113-S3 SoC with a Quectel EC25 LTE module. The software already works well on a MangoPi dev board, and two PCBs have been designed: a test-fit board that breaks the phone's keypad and LCD out to pin headers, and the actual full board. Voice calling works over LTE (verified on T-Mobile in the US); the next step is ordering the PCBA, which is expensive. Videos and photos of the test setup and board layout are on the project page.
mentions.problem: Making voice calling work over LTE is tricky because of carrier rules.
